CertificateId: [NOTES] CertificateId must reference existing Certificate.Id. DocumentType options: Certificate Supporting TestReport Photo Other. FileName is display name. FilePath is relative path from wwwroot/uploads/ directory. FileSize in bytes (optional). FileHash is SHA-256 hash for integrity verification (calculate with Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256). UploadedBy references User.Id (optional). Before importing ensure physical files are copied to correct directory and paths match exactly. System will validate file existence during import.
